projects.name: Dark Roast Café
projects.d: Locally grown coffee roasted in-house, across from Lake Gregory in Nuwara Eliya. Waffles, fresh juices and the D.R.C signatures — with the 5.0 Google rating and daily hours stated right up front.

projects.name: The Kubana
projects.d: A timber A-frame chalet on Upper Lake Road, Nuwara Eliya — stone fireplace, a bath beside the fire and a loft under the eaves. Polaroid-stacked gallery, with the Booking.com and Google ratings stated up front.

projects.name: Hot Bowl Satwa
projects.d: Home-style Filipino comfort food in Satwa, Dubai — bulalo, silogs, bilao platters and halo-halo. Live open/closed status, a 4.9-star Google review panel, and ordering one tap away by call or WhatsApp.

projects.name: Restaurant in the Reef
projects.d: A resort restaurant at Reef Resort Villas in Port Douglas, serving breakfast through dinner. Sage-and-cream palette, a live open/closed indicator in the hero, and the menu one tap from the top.

projects.name: Themparadu
projects.d: A taste of Sri Lankan heritage, up in the hills of Nuwara Eliya. Dark, food-forward design built around the two things a hungry visitor actually wants — the menu, and a one-tap call button.

projects.name: Forest Feast
projects.d: An organic farm-to-table restaurant inside a greenhouse in Blackpool, Nuwara Eliya, with a quiet farm stay next door. Warm editorial layout that splits diners and overnight guests into two clear paths.

projects.name: COCOE
projects.d: A pre-order fashion store for shoes, clothing and bags. Category browsing, sale pricing and a three-step pre-order flow — order, pay half, delivered island-wide to all 25 districts.

projects.name: Sanelco Display
projects.d: A supermarket price board built for a screen on the shop wall. Live clock, rotating promotions and today’s prices in Sinhala and Tamil — updated weekly without anyone touching the code.

projects.name: Creastation Digital
projects.d: Outcome-driven digital agency — brand strategy, content creation, performance marketing and high-conversion websites. A motion-led dark identity carrying over ten years of creative work.

projects.name: This Portfolio
projects.d: The site you are on. A cinematic single-page portfolio with scroll-scrubbed scenes, a horizontal career timeline, a GEO section on AI search — and the pricing page next door.
